name: Custom: Pre-cool the living room to 70F bef
description: Synthesized [hvac] skill: Pre-cool the living room to 70F before the 4pm peak tariff

note.default: Pre-cool the living room to 70F before the 4pm peak tariff

intent.raw: Pre-cool the living room to 70F before the 4pm peak tariff

sample_out.requirement: Pre-cool the living room to 70F before the 4pm peak tariff

savings_formula: domain=hvac: t = float(params.get('target_temp_f', 70.0)); hour = int(params.get('schedule_hour', 14)); peak = 0.52 if 16 <= hour <= 20 else 0.28; savings = round(max(0.0, (72.0 - t) * 0.35 + (0.52 - peak) * 4.0), 2)
